title: 第1章 夜

content_zh:
此时已是初夏，外面的天才刚刚彻底暗下来，浅淡的夜色笼罩着少女的面庞，借着案上烛光，依稀能看清帐内少女的模样。
少女眉若远山，琼鼻樱唇，桃腮雪肤，竟是个顶出色的美人儿。
少女乃是东平伯府姜家排行第四的姑娘，单名一个似字。
阿蛮见了姜似的样子，心头便升腾起一股怒火，为自家姑娘打抱起不平来。
那安国公府的三公子莫非瞎了眼不成，凭姑娘的模样进宫当娘娘都够了，他却对这门亲事不甚热衷，莫不是觉得姑娘配不上他？
阿蛮的怒火源于春日的一场诗会。
那诗会是京中一些名门公子举办的，无非就是一些年轻人凑在一起喝酒吟诗取乐，等到酒意微醺，便有人对安国公府的三公子季崇易开起玩笑来，言语间颇羡慕他将要与京中出名的美人儿完婚了。
谁知季崇易带着酒意自嘲一笑，说了句：“生的如何不过是一副皮囊罢了，女子当以品性温良柔善为重。”
原本是年轻人的醉话，听听也就过去了，酒醒了自然风过无痕，谁知这话不知怎么就传了出去，姜家的四姑娘顿时成了人们茶余饭后的笑谈。
东平伯府本来就根基浅薄，爵位只能承袭三世，到了姜似的父亲东平伯这一代已经是第三世了，是以姜似的兄长连世子都没请封。
也就是说，等东平伯百年之后，东平伯府便会从勋贵圈子中退出去，成为普通人家。
就是这样人家的姑娘，居然与安国公府定了亲，先不谈其中机缘，这足以令许多人看高攀上安国公府的姜似不顺眼了。
安国公府的三公子季崇易说女子美貌不重要，他更看重脾气秉性，这言下之意，不就是嫌弃姜四姑娘秉性不佳么？
无论季崇易说这话是有心还是无意，这话一传出来立刻让姜似丢了好大的脸，再出门参加贵女们的聚会，便听了一肚子闲言碎语。
姜似是个气性大的，回来便病了，这一病就是半个月。
躺在床榻上闭目养神的姜似霍然睁开了眼睛。
她的眼睛弧度极美，到了眼尾微微上翘，勾勒出难以言说的秾丽风流。
此时这双极美的眸子与阿蛮的对上，露出浅淡笑意来：“做出一副要吃人的样子干什么？”
“想到某人有眼无珠，婢子就替姑娘生气。”
姜似眼底笑意飞快逝去，嘴角弧度却加深，淡淡道：“那人又没见过我，谈不上有眼无珠。”

“姑娘，您还替他说话呀！”瞧着短短半个月瘦了一圈的姑娘，阿蛮一阵心疼与不服气。
半个月前姑娘去永昌伯府赴赏花宴回来便大哭一场，连最喜爱的玉貔貅摆件都砸碎了，提起安国公府的三公子更是恨得咬牙切齿，怎么现在却变了呢？
“不是替他说话，一句醉话而已。”姜似眼眸一转，看向立在屏风旁的另一名婢女阿巧，吩咐道，“阿巧，去把前几日让你做的两套衣裳拿来吧。”
不多时阿巧捧来两套衣裳，其中一套给了阿蛮，另一套则伺候姜似穿上。
阿蛮一边往身上套衣裳一边忿忿道：“一句醉话害得姑娘被人笑话哩。”
姜似眼底冷意更深了，干脆闭上了眸子，轻声道：“这算得了什么？”
她一生的不幸，就是从这场门不当户不对的亲事开始的。
想当初，年少无知，她是多么得意能与安国公府的公子定亲，谁知那位三公子季崇易早就有了心上人。
季崇易的心上人是一位民家女。
她嫁过去后才陆陆续续知道，那位民女机缘巧合救了出门游玩遇险的季崇易，季崇易在女子家养伤数日才被国公府找到，二人已生出情愫来，此后一直偷偷来往。
而在她还对这段婚姻充满憧憬与得意时，季崇易为了能与心上人相守已经向家中长辈反抗过多回了。
婚事已经近在眼前，安国公府自然不许季崇易胡闹，更何况他想娶的是连姜家都不如的平民女子，季崇易的反抗与不满自然没有流传出只言片语。
姜似想到季崇易的酒后吐真言，便觉得那时候的自己蠢得可以，恼怒过后竟忍不住替他找出理由，认为他不流于俗，不是那些只在乎女子容貌的庸俗男子，说那句话只是就事论事罢了。
去他的就事论事，就在今晚，景明十八年四月十五的夜里，这位不流于俗的名门贵公子竟与心上人一起跑到莫忧湖畔，跳湖殉情。

content_en:
It was already early summer, and the outside world had just completely darkened. The light night cover the girl's face, and through the candlelight on the table, the girl's appearance inside the tent could be vaguely seen.
The girl has eyebrows like distant mountains, a beautiful nose and cherry lips, and peach cheeks and snowy skin. She is actually an outstanding beauty.
The girl is the fourth girl in the Jiang family of Dongping Prefecture, and her name has a similar character.
When Ah Man saw Jiang Xi's appearance, a surge of anger arose in his heart, and he started to defend his girl.
Could it be that the third son of Duke An Guo is blind? It's enough for him to enter the palace and become a empress based on the girl's appearance, but he is not very enthusiastic about this marriage. Could it be that he feels that the girl is not worthy of him?
Aman's anger originated from a poetry meeting in spring.
The poetry meeting was held by some famous young men in the capital. It was nothing more than a group of young people getting together to drink and recite poems for fun. When they were tipsy, someone began to joke to Ji Chongyi, the third son of Duke Anguo, and expressed envy that he was about to get married to a famous beauty in the capital.
Unexpectedly, Ji Chongyi laughed at himself in a drunken mood and said: "No matter how you are born, you are just a skin. A woman should put gentleness, gentleness and kindness first."
It was originally a drunken talk of young people, but it was over after hearing it. After sobering up, the wind passed without a trace. Unexpectedly, the words spread out somehow, and the fourth girl of the Jiang family suddenly became a joke among people after dinner.
The foundation of Dongpingbo's house was shallow, and the title could only be inherited for three generations. Jiang Si's father, Dongpingbo, was already the third generation, so Jiang Si's brother didn't even ask for the title of heir apparent.
In other words, after a hundred years of Uncle Dongping, Uncle Dongping's mansion will withdraw from the circle of nobles and become an ordinary family.
It was a girl from such a family who actually got engaged to Duke An Guo. Let's not talk about the chance. This was enough to make many people dislike Jiang Si, who had climbed up to Duke An Guo's house.
Ji Chongyi, the third son of Duke An Guo, said that a woman's beauty is not important, and that he values ​​temperament more. Doesn't this imply that he dislikes the fourth girl Jiang for her poor temperament?
Regardless of whether Ji Chongyi said this intentionally or unintentionally, Jiang Si was immediately embarrassed as soon as he said it. When he went out to attend a gathering of ladies, he heard a lot of gossip.
Jiang seemed to have a strong temper and became ill when he came back. He remained ill for half a month.
Jiang Si, who was lying on the bed with his eyes closed and concentrating, suddenly opened his eyes.
The curvature of her eyes is extremely beautiful, and the ends of her eyes are slightly upward, outlining an indescribable beauty and grace.
At this moment, these extremely beautiful eyes met Aman's, revealing a faint smile: "Why do you look like you want to eat people?"
"When I think of someone who is short-sighted, I get angry on behalf of the girl."
The smile in Jiang Si's eyes quickly disappeared, but the curvature of the corners of his mouth deepened, and he said lightly: "That person has never seen me, so he can't be said to be blind."
"Girl, you still speak for him!" Looking at the girl who had lost weight in just half a month, Ah Man felt distressed and unconvinced.
Half a month ago, the girl went to the Yongchang Mansion for a flower-viewing banquet and burst into tears when she came back. She even smashed her favorite jade ornament. When the third young master of the Anguo Mansion was mentioned, he gritted his teeth with hatred. Why has it changed now?
"I'm not speaking for him, just a drunken remark." Jiang Si turned his eyes and looked at the other maid, Ah Qiao, who was standing by the screen, and ordered, "Ah Qiao, go get the two sets of clothes I asked you to make a few days ago."
Not long after, Ah Qiao brought two sets of clothes, one of which was given to Ah Man, and the other was for Jiang Si to put on.
Ah Man said angrily as he put on his clothes: "A drunken remark made the girl laugh."
The coldness in Jiang Si's eyes became even deeper, he simply closed his eyes and said softly: "What does this mean?"
The misfortune of her life began with this inappropriate marriage.
Thinking back to when she was young and ignorant, she was so proud to be engaged to the prince of Duke Anguo. Who knew that the third prince, Ji Chongyi, had already had a sweetheart.
Ji ChongYi's sweetheart is a girl from a private family.
After she got married, she came to know one after another that by chance, the civilian girl rescued Ji Chongyi who was in danger while out for fun. Ji Chongyi recovered from his injuries at the woman's house for several days before he was found by the Duke's government. The two had developed a love and had been secretly communicating with each other since then.
While she was still full of longing and pride for this marriage, Ji Chongyi had rebelled against her elders many times in order to stay with her sweetheart.
The marriage was imminent, and the Anguo Palace naturally did not allow Ji Chongyi to mess around. What's more, he wanted to marry a commoner woman who was not even as good as the Jiang family. Naturally, Ji Chongyi's resistance and dissatisfaction did not spread a word.
Jiang Si thought of Ji Chongyi's drunken utterance, and felt that he was very stupid at that time. After getting angry, he couldn't help but find a reason for him, thinking that he was not vulgar, not one of those vulgar men who only care about a woman's appearance, and what he said was just a matter of fact.
Forget about talking about matters, tonight, on the night of April 15th, the eighteenth year of Jingming Dynasty, this unconventional and famous son actually ran to the shore of Moyou Lake with his sweetheart and jumped into the lake to die in love.
